title: Move automations and knowledge query onto the signed-in lane
description: papyrus automations run/list/runs invoke Lambda and read the monitoring table although runAutomation and automationOverview exist server-side (automation_view.py): switch the CLI to them. papyrus knowledge query calls iam_signed_graphql_headers directly: use the user session. No new server API expected.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Signed-in lane implemented on feature/PPY-544564-automations-knowledge-login. automations list|show|runs|run now ask automationOverview and runAutomation when a papyrus login session applies (IAM lane kept for PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_AUTH=iam). Refused on the signed-in lane because the server has no equivalent: run --dry-run, and runs --limit above the site default (5). knowledge query remote uses the session (new --site option); --execution local still needs AWS (S3, S3 Vectors). Shared helper factored into signed_in_lane.py; graphql_request_headers untouched (PPY-5f119a).
